_comment: Demo payload — fictional day, no personal data. Real briefs are written to data/brief.json (gitignored). See README.
headline: Two blocks carry the whole day, and the afternoon is yours to spend.

stages.name: DEEP WORK
stages.log: Opens the day for one task, uninterrupted. Nothing else is scheduled against it.

stages.name: EXECUTION BLOCK
stages.log: Three hours on revenue work — the longest uninterrupted run on the board.

quests.title: Ship the pricing page rewrite
quests.body: Top of your objectives list this week, and the only item on it with a date attached.

quests.title: Contract redline needs a yes or no
quests.body: From your co-founder on Sunday — they're blocked until you confirm the payment terms clause.

stages.name: CONTROL BLOCK
stages.log: Planning and life admin, with tomorrow's review sitting just past it.

quests.title: Quarter review lands tomorrow at nine
quests.body: You're the organizer, so the prep is the agenda you'll open with — three things that moved, one that didn't.

stages.name: FLEX BLOCK
stages.log: Light and creative, marked free — the one stretch that can be traded away without cost.

stages.name: UNWIND BLOCK
stages.log: Closes the run, easing toward sleep.

items.title: Insurance renewal closes today
items.body: A reminder in your inbox from last Tuesday — cover lapses at midnight if the form isn't back.

items.title: Draft the case study you keep deferring
items.body: On your objectives list since January, with no deadline attached and no routine it fits.

items.title: Two RSVPs expire tonight
items.body: Both are optional events next month; either answer takes a line.

items.title: Server migration finished overnight
items.body: The thread you were copied on closed itself — ops confirmed cutover at 04:12, nothing pending.
